notes: Added missing recovery, TTL enforcement, and test coverage stories.

GOV-F-003-S53.title: TTL Expiration and Auto-Cleanup Logic
GOV-F-003-S53.description: Implement TTL enforcement logic that automatically expires locks based on expires_at and cleans up stale locks. Ensure expired locks are treated as available for acquisition and do not block new executions.

GOV-F-003-S54.title: Crash Recovery and Lock Reacquisition
GOV-F-003-S54.description: Implement recovery logic to allow new processes to detect expired or abandoned locks and safely reacquire them. Include safeguards to prevent double execution and ensure idempotent recovery behavior.

GOV-F-003-S55.title: Lock Contention Handling and Ownership Validation
GOV-F-003-S55.description: Implement strict ownership validation ensuring only the lock owner can renew or release a lock. Add contention handling logic for concurrent acquisition attempts with deterministic resolution and error signaling.

GOV-F-003-S56.title: Brain Lock Unit and Integration Tests
GOV-F-003-S56.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiry, renewal, release, contention scenarios, and crash recovery. Validate behavior under concurrent execution conditions.
